card.title: Fake the Expertise
card.instruction: Perform expertise so confidently that no one questions you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get your boiler running. I know these controls.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've been adjusting the kitchen timer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Establishing the heating interval. Call the engineer; I'll need someone on the boiler.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He asks what temperature you measured.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him we're still establishing the baseline. Put him on speaker; I'll ask the questions so he can concentrate on readings.

mechanism: A maintains unchallengeable boiler expertise by recasting an obvious wrong control and taking charge of the real engineer's questions.
confusable: Unlike honestly asking for help, A must preserve the authoritative performance while shifting technical work to someone else.
comparison: D18-a claims supervisory questioning over the engineer; D18-b claims inspection authority after snapping a violin string.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
